title: PUT /v1/workgroups/{wg}/attachments/{object}/chunks/{index} request
description: Body of PUT /v1/workgroups/{wg}/attachments/{object}/chunks/{index} (03-api.md section 4.6, ADR-102 section 3): one sealed chunk of a file attached to a prompt (nonce || AES-GCM, at most 1 MiB + 28 bytes, 04-crypto.md section 4.14).
